skill.summary: Internal email system for HERA agents to send, receive, read, and manage direct messages with optional file attachments.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of HERA Mail – the internal email system for agent-to-agent communication within the HERA research assistant framework.

- Enables agents to check inbox, read, send, and manage internal emails with optional file attachments.
- Provides scripts for listing, reading, and sending messages between agents.
- Supports direct, formal-free communication and file sharing (papers, code, data, images).
- Documents standard workflows, message types, agent names, email formatting, and best practices.
- Includes troubleshooting and directory structure guidance.
